note: raw_answer is the model's own text; final_answer is after deterministic repair and is not a model-quality figure
methodology: Sentence-level. SUPPORTED: cites an exact source, shares at least 50% of its content words with it and no deterministic check failed on it. NOT SUPPORTED: a deterministic check failed on the sentence (missing provision asserted, figure absent from sources, wrong-source citation) or it shares under 25% of its content words with what it cites. UNCERTAIN: everything between. Refusals and not-found statements are N/A.
limitations: Word overlap is not entailment: a paraphrase can share words and still misstate the source, and a correct restatement in different words can score UNCERTAIN. Treat NOT SUPPORTED as reliable and SUPPORTED as unproven.
